recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17250 unless PA later changes which resource owns the name/alias search semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-17250 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request raised against ProductPlan in STU3. It asked to change the ProductPlan name search parameter expression from `name | alias` to `ProductPlan.name | ProductPlan.alias`; the resolution noted the original unqualified FHIRPath was valid but accepted the change for consistency.
initial_application: PA minutes recorded a 5-0-1 persuasive vote in January 2019. Commit 614e254d88b3c419c51d87958f6ef3bf3308cc25 later applied the issue by changing the then-current InsurancePlan name search expression from `name | alias` to `InsurancePlan.name | InsurancePlan.alias`.
additional_context: ProductPlan is historical in current fhir.ini, with InsurancePlan and InsuranceProduct active. Later Applied work in FHIR-24827 split InsurancePlan/InsuranceProduct, and FHIR-33272 added an InsurancePlan.product search parameter. Current InsuranceProduct owns the name/alias fields and its name search parameter already uses `InsuranceProduct.name | InsuranceProduct.alias`; current InsurancePlan has no name/alias search parameter.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already reflects the accepted expression style in the active successor artifact, and adding a name search parameter back to InsurancePlan would contradict the later model split.
